newsitem.title: USA: Petrobras ADR could start trade this week.
newsitem.headline: Petrobras ADR could start trade this week.

text.p: Brazil's state oil company Petrobras SA could see the first trades this week in its newly established American Depositary Receipt (ADR), a Citibank source said on Monday.
The source, who asked for anonymity, said it was still too early to mark any trades in the Level 1 ADR despite a high level of interest from potential investors.
The Petrobras ADR program was established by Citibank last week. Each ADR represents 100 ordinary Petrobras shares.
"No one has actually begun to convert the shares into ADRs. I expect to see that in the next few days," he said.

Under the program, investors can buy Petrobras shares then convert them to ADRs through the Citibank facility. The ADRs then trade in the over-the-counter market in the United States priced in dollars under U.S. securities laws, with dividends paid in dollars.
